style1.headline: Brand & web designer
style1.tagline: I help small businesses look as good online as they do in person.
style1.aboutText:
I'm Maya, a brand and web designer based in Cebu.

For the last eight years I've helped cafés, clinics, and family businesses look like the version of themselves they want customers to meet — clear logos, warm websites, and print that feels considered.

Most of my work is one-on-one with the owner. No handoff to a stranger halfway through.
style1.servicesIntro: Fixed-scope projects, quoted before we start.

services.title: Brand identity
services.description: Logo, colours, type, and a one-page guide you can hand to any printer.

services.title: One-page website
services.description: A fast, mobile-first site with your story, services, and a way to message you.

services.title: Menu & print
services.description: Menus, packaging, and storefront signage that match your brand.

work.description: A full rebrand for a three-branch coffee shop, from packaging to signage.
A calm, appointment-first site for a family dental clinic.
Shelf-ready packaging for a homegrown snack brand.

testimonials.text: Maya took a messy idea and gave us a brand we're proud to put on the door.
testimonials.author: Ana Lim

testimonials.text: She asked better questions than any agency we talked to — and delivered early.
testimonials.author: Dr. Rey Tan

faq.question: How long does a project take?
faq.answer: A one-page site is usually two to three weeks. Full branding runs four to six.

faq.question: Do you work with clients outside Cebu?
faq.answer: Yes — most of my work is remote, with calls scheduled in your time zone.

style1.contactIntro: Tell me what you're building. I reply within one working day.
style1.messengerNote: Opens Messenger with your message ready to send.

style2.headline: Operations & growth consultant
style2.tagline: I help founder-led companies build the operating rhythm that lets them grow without the chaos.
style2.aboutText:
I spent eleven years running operations inside growing Philippine companies before starting Cruz Advisory in 2021.

I work with founders who have product-market fit but are drowning in process debt — the kind that shows up as missed deadlines, key-person risk, and a team that can't tell you what 'done' means.

My work is hands-on. We diagnose together, fix the two or three things that actually move the business, then hand your team a system they can run without me.
style2.servicesIntro: Three ways to engage, depending on what stage you are in.

services.title: Operations diagnostic
services.description: A two-week review of your team, tools, and delivery cycle, ending with a prioritised action plan.

services.title: Fractional COO
services.description: Two days a week inside your leadership team, owning delivery and hiring until you are ready to hire your own.

services.title: Founder advisory
services.description: A standing monthly session for founders who need a thinking partner, not a consultant deck.

work.description: Advised 30+ founder-led companies on operations, hiring, and delivery.
Built the operating model that took the company from 40 to 400 employees.
Ran store operations for a 60-branch retail network.

testimonials.text: Daniel rebuilt our delivery process in six weeks. The same team now ships twice as much without working later.
testimonials.author: Patricia Go

testimonials.text: He tells you what he actually thinks, which is rarer and more useful than it sounds.
testimonials.author: Miguel Tan

faq.question: Do you take equity?
faq.answer: No. I charge a flat monthly fee so my advice stays independent.

faq.question: What size company do you work with?
faq.answer: Usually 15 to 250 people, founder-led, past product-market fit.

style2.contactIntro: Send a short note about your company and what is not working. If I can help, we will book a call.

style3.headline: Content creator & photographer
style3.tagline: Travel, food, and the people behind small brands — shot on location in the Philippines.
style3.aboutText:
I make photos and short-form video for travel brands, restaurants, and people who are proud of what they build.

I started posting Davao food walks in 2019. Six years later I split my time between commissioned shoots and my own series about small businesses in Mindanao.

If you want polished but not plastic, we will get along.
style3.servicesIntro: Rates are starting points. Tell me the story and we will scope it properly.

services.title: Brand shoot
services.description: Half-day photo session: menu, product, team, and space, delivered in a shared gallery.

services.title: Short-form video
services.description: Three vertical videos edited for Reels, TikTok, and Facebook.

services.title: Travel feature
services.description: A destination story for tourism boards and hotels, photo and video.

work.description: A self-published series on 80+ small food businesses in Mindanao.
Photo and video for a seasonal campaign, shot over four days.
Packaging photography and a content library for a local roaster.

testimonials.text: Kai made our whole team relax on camera. The photos are still the ones we use everywhere.
testimonials.author: Bea Ong

testimonials.text: Fast, kind, and genuinely creative. Our bookings went up the week the videos went live.
testimonials.author: Marco Diaz

faq.question: Do you travel outside Davao?
faq.answer: Yes. Travel is quoted separately, and I waive it for advocacy projects.

faq.question: How do I get the photos?
faq.answer: A private online gallery with full-resolution downloads, usually within seven days.

style3.contactIntro: Send me your dates, location, and what you want people to feel when they see it.
style3.messengerNote: Opens Messenger with your message ready to send.

style4.headline: Software engineer
style4.tagline: Backend systems, payments, and the unglamorous work that keeps products running.
style4.aboutText:
I build and maintain backend systems for fintech and e-commerce teams.

Most of my work is in Go and TypeScript: payment flows, reconciliation jobs, and the APIs that sit between them. I care about clear failure modes, useful logs, and tests that catch real problems.

Outside work I maintain a small open-source library for webhook retries and write occasionally about production incidents.

work.description: Own the payments API and reconciliation pipeline processing about ₱2B monthly.
Built order and inventory services for a nationwide sari-sari store platform.
Worked across a Go monolith and the React admin tools around it.

style4.contactIntro: Email is the best way to reach me.
